title: "DEN Working Papers"
---

The page hosts my paper projects at Dewan Ekonomi Nasional (DEN)[^1]. Not all what I do at DEN is making papers, but when I do, I host it here. This project is a collaborative effort with many talented individuals at the council, whom it is a great privilege to work with.

These papers are mostly works in progress and still frequently updated, so please cite it with care. Comments are very welcomed and feel free to reach me via email or X.

- [Projecting GDP with night light index](/nitelite) with Timothy Ginting

- [Projecting the impact of Trump's reciprocal tariff to Indonesian economy](/trumptariff) with Arief Yusuf, Shakuntala Nindraswari, and Hafizh Ghifari.

[^1]: National Economic Council, Republic of Indonesia
